summary: 3.7.2 uses the Docker CLI's current context (Rancher Desktop) and no longer records HTTP streams as test cases. 3.7.1 fixes agent PID mapping, loopback ports, `//path` parsing, and MySQL mock errors.
Adds a parser-contract for mock-noise and miss reporting. Reusable mocks now keep the union of learned `req_body_noise`, so saved mock files can change (#4943).
